title: Vibrant Caramelized Venezuelan Yukon Gold Potatoes Hash
description: A mustardy and snappy Venezuelan dish featuring caramelized Yukon gold potatoes, perfect for a sick day, this low-calorie-friendly recipe is a delicious and healthy option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize, about 8 minutes.
Add the roasted potatoes to the skillet with the onion and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the yellow mustard and cook for 1 minute, until the potatoes are well coated.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the chopped cilantro.
Serve the potato hash hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
